resources.string: QR code: transfer directly between two devices. Large backups are split into several codes.
On the other device: Settings, Backup, \"Import via QR code\", then scan all codes shown here. With several codes, the order does not matter.
Favorite contacts are included (names and phone numbers).
Without a password, anyone who sees or photographs the screen can read the contents. The password is not stored and not part of the code; it has to be entered on the other device.
The backup is too large for QR codes (more than %1$d codes). Leave out contacts or use the file transfer.
The code could not be created.
The screen stays on; screenshots are blocked for this view.
Point the camera at the code on the other device. With several codes, scan them all one after another.
This code is not a MiriquidiLauncher backup.
Code of a different backup detected. The codes read so far were discarded.
The codes are damaged. Please scan again.
The existing favorites will be replaced by the contents of the scanned codes.
